free_resources.title: Calm Adrenals
free_resources.description: A recorded vinyasa class from Mary's studio, active but calming, for days when you feel stressed and stretched thin. A practice guide can be downloaded to read before the first session.

flags: The episode's 'Adrenals fried?' is a casual way of saying stressed; no claim to treat any condition, so it passes the 12 Nov rule.
This brings the listing to 5 free resources (the cap; plan count, live not re-counted).
